item_short_desc: Stay hydrated on the go with Rothco’s MOLLE Attachable Hydration Pack. This versatile hydration pack can be worn as a standalone backpack or easily attached to your existing gear thanks to the MOLLE-compatible straps. It comes equipped with a 2-liter hydration bladder complete with a convenient mouthpiece and on/off valve for easy access to water during outdoor activities. The pack's main zippered compartment provides extra storage for small essentials, while an interior mesh pocket with a zipper closure keeps items organized.
description: Stay hydrated on the go with Rothco’s MOLLE Attachable Hydration Pack. This versatile hydration pack can be worn as a standalone backpack or easily attached to your existing gear thanks to the MOLLE-compatible straps. It comes equipped with a 2-liter hydration bladder complete with a convenient mouthpiece and on/off valve for easy access to water during outdoor activities. The pack's main zippered compartment provides extra storage for small essentials, while an interior mesh pocket with a zipper closure keeps items organized. Adjustable and removable shoulder straps ensure a comfortable fit, and D-rings allow for added versatility. The hydration pack also features a top carry handle for easy transport and a loop field on the front panel for attaching patches or identification. Measuring 16.5 inch x 6.6 inch x 3 inch, this pack is perfect for hiking, biking, or any outdoor adventure.
